events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Hull City 1, Manchester United 0. Semi Ajayi (Hull City) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal following a corner.
Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Hull City 2, Manchester United 0. Nobel Mendy (Hull City) header from very close range to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Regan Slater with a cross following a set piece situation.
Matt Crooks (Hull City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Hull City 2, Manchester United 0.
Substitution, Manchester United. Marcus Rashford replaces Patrick Dorgu.
Second Half begins Hull City 2, Manchester United 0.
Substitution, Hull City. Lucas Herrington replaces Nobel Mendy because of an injury.
Substitution, Hull City. Paddy McNair replaces Semi Ajayi.
Substitution, Manchester United. Benjamin Sesko replaces Andrey Santos.
Substitution, Manchester United. Kobbie Mainoo replaces Youri Tielemans.

Liam Millar (Hull City) is shown the yellow card.
